reviews.text:
I just wanted to give a HUGE shoutout to Oliwia! She has been taking care of my Bernese Mountain Dog, Myra, with weekday walks for almost a year now, and she has been nothing short of amazing.

Myra was adopted from a puppy mill and struggled with separation anxiety and trusting new people. Oliwia was incredibly patient with her from the very beginning, allowing her to build trust at her own pace. Now, Myra absolutely ADORES her.

I work long hours, so having the peace of mind knowing that Myra is in such caring and capable hands has been great.  Oliwia sends the most wonderful photos every day. In fact, my parents, who live all the way in Canada, loved the pictures so much that they insisted on being added to the group chat just so they could see them too!

Oliwia has become such an important part of Myra’s life, and I’m incredibly grateful for everything she does ❤️

Outpaws are a fantastic walking service! Extremely attentive to our pups needs and very accommodating. Loaise and her team are fantastic and so easy and friendly to deal with. Toby loves his walkers Oliwia and Janel and the pictures they take on walks are unreal!
Excellent, my dog is very happy with them !

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

Oliwia and Karolina have looked after my four pets, two dog & two cats and house-sat for me on a number of occasions, and I honestly couldn’t recommend them highly enough.

Louis is a very elderly Pomeranian with heart issues, so he needs that little bit of extra care and attention, including his daily medication. The girls take care of all of this and give him an abundance of patience, affection and cuddles. Rosie, on the other hand, is a pup and firmly believes all attention should be hers at all times! They have endless patience with her and all her demands. Ollie and Poppy are a little more laid-back, but they certainly don’t miss out on their share of rubs, cuddles and attention either.

My pets are a huge part of my life, and being able to leave them in their own home, where they’re happiest and most comfortable, means so much to me. Knowing that both my pets and my home are in such safe and trustworthy hands means I can go away on holiday and genuinely switch off and relax and that, for me, speaks volumes.

I’m genuinely indebted to the whole crew for the care they give my little gang and my home. Finding people you can completely trust with both is priceless, and I feel incredibly lucky to have found them. ❤️🐾

Thank you Laoise, Karolina & Oliwia
Outstanding service and the most caring dog walkers. Highly recommend.

Laoise and the team at Outpaws are fantastic, my dog Winnie has been doing two walks per week for a few months now and I always feel as though she is well cared for and loved by them. They are so reliable and flexible and they truly have a passion for giving dogs great care. Laoise also has a wealth of knowledge on the health and care of dogs, always offering advice when needed. We love Outpaws 💕

Outpaws provided a fantastic service for us and our dog George, he had a great time on his daily walks. The girls are so good with George and very reliable giving up dates every day. We would 100% recommend this service .

We have been very happy with the OutPaws team since they started walking our labradoodle 6 months ago now. She is so excited to see them when they arrive and is exhausted when she comes back - hail, rain or shine! Communication is excellent, lots of happy puppy photos after every walk and the team are just very reliable overall!
I would highly recommend OUTPAWS , Laoise was very good and the girls who minded Cooper was very kind and nice . Cooper suffers from anxiety but they were so good that he settled very well .

Amazing service, Freddie loves day care and has been going for the past 4 years. It’s such a comfort to know he’s being well looked after when we’re at work. Laoise and her staff are so professional, caring and go above and beyond to ensure their clients needs are met. Couldn’t recommend them more :-)

We highly recommend Laoise for her dog-minding and walking services. She has been minding our 2 yr old scottish terrier girl twice a week for a couple of months now, and she comes home happy and content every day, which has given us enormous peace of mind.
The positive impact she has had on our furbaby's wellbeing, confidence, and happiness has been truly remarkable.
Laoise shows incredible patience, understanding, and genuine care for our dog’s individual needs - which is why we switched to her in the first place, having heard through word-of-mouth about her. She doesn’t take a one-size-fits-all approach, but instead really gets to know each dog’s personality, routines, and sensitivities. I can’t stress enough how dedicated she is to each and every dog in her care’s wellbeing! As a result, our girl has really blossomed under Laoise’s care. Laoise's calm, consistent approach and dedication have helped our anxious dog feel much more secure and relaxed, and we’ve seen huge improvements in her behaviour as a result.
Laoise also has a depth of experience and professional networks that she has been able to utilise to advise us, connecting us to a highly regarded dog behaviourist when we asked about getting some training and behavioural analysis help. Her guidance was invaluable to us.
One thing that really sets Laoise apart and gives us peace-of-mind is that she limits her daycare to a maximum of 7 dogs per day, which means that every dog in her care gets plenty of individual attention, affection, exercise, and supervision rather than the doggies being overwhelmed in a large group. Overall, we have nothing but positive words and praise for Laoise and her team!!!

We cannot recommend Laoise and her team enough for their amazing, dedicated and loving puppy concierge service! They have really helped with our puppy’s development and growth.

From day one our 16 week old puppy was cared for with such kindness and love we would never have gotten through the months without them.

Such efficiency and care was given by all of the Outpaws team, our puppy is transitioning into Outpaws Day Care and we are looking forward to the results.  Thanks to all the girls!

For over 5 years, our dog Elba has attended Outpaws. Whether in daycare or on her favorite solo walks, she treats it like a second home, racing inside each morning for new adventures that keep her happy and engaged.
What sets Laoise apart is the individual care. She doesn't just "watch" the dogs; she adores them. She goes above and beyond just to make their day special, and ensures she and her team knows every dog on an individual basis.
Elba has also done overnight stays; and the professionalism has been nothing short of amazing; ensuring she has the most lovely stay away from home, while keeping us updated at all times and managing the logistics seamlessly.
Beyond the walks, Laoise is an incredible resource. She is always on hand to advise on health, behavior, , and she works so hard to accommodate our requests. If you want a place where your dog is treated as an individual and loved like family, Outpaws is it.
Fantastic dog walkers! Great at communicating and my dog is always so excited to see them! Couldn’t recommend them more

They went above and beyond when I moved to Dublin to arrange the dog walking. Always reliable and my dog absolutely loved the walks. If you are in need for someone reliable and lovely for your dog - this is it :) Thank you so much!

Absolutely fantastic service!

OutPaws have been amazing with our two dogs; our Boxer, Tommy, and our rescue Terrier, Arlo. Laoise is incredibly kind, attentive, and thoughtful. She treats the boys like her own and they absolutely adore her and the team.

She even looked after them during our wedding day, dressing them in little tuxedos and top hats, it was the sweetest touch and meant so much to us! No request was ever too big, and we always know they’re in the best hands.

Couldn’t recommend OutPaws highly enough -truly a five-star service!
Laoise and the girls are absolutely amazing! She completely cares for and loves the dogs  as if they are her own. We don’t know what we would do without Outpaws. Can’t recommend her enough!

Laoise & the Outpaws team truly provide a home away from home for Maisie and all the dogs they mind. The care is top level and the exercise and adventures on walks are brilliant. The team are great to deal with, responsive and friendly.

We’ve been using Outpaws for over four years now and couldn’t recommend them more highly. Laoise and her team have been incredible with our dog Saffy, and the level of care, flexibility, and professionalism they offer is second to none.

Saffy absolutely adores Laoise – she gets visibly excited every time she sees her! Whether it’s daycare, walks, or overnight stays, Saffy always comes back happy, relaxed, and nicely tired out. It’s clear that Laoise genuinely cares about the dogs in her care, always keeping an eye on Saffy’s health and energy levels.

One of the standout moments was our wedding day – Laoise organised everything through her "Wedding Woof" service. Saffy arrived beautifully clean, walked, and perfectly calm. One of Laoise’s lovely assistants stayed with her during the ceremony and photos, and then whisked her away before the dinner – it was completely stress-free for us and such a special touch having Saffy there on the day.

The overnight minding service has also been a lifesaver, especially with last-minute plans – Laoise always seems to have a reliable team member available. Even on work-from-home days, she’s kindly swung by for a morning walk with Saffy so I can focus on meetings.

Outpaws is a rare find – reliable, caring, and totally dog-focused. If you're looking for someone who treats your dog like their own, look no further than Laoise and her amazing team.

Laoise and the Outpaws team are absolutely amazing! My dog receives the most incredible care and is always so happy and relaxed when i pick him up. They go on plenty of adventures to beaches, parks, and get tons of love and attention. I feel completely at ease knowing he is in such caring hands. Highly recommended!

Laoise and her OutPaws team are the best. Our dog Ruby has been part of the OutPaws community for several years. She enjoys all of the Bespoke services that OutPaws offer (walking, daycare, and minding) Laoise and her team have been great to work with and they truly love all the Woofs!
I would highly recommend Outpaws . Our Vizsla Charlie loves to see them coming to mind him

OutPaws has been a game-changer for our dog Walter, a longhaired miniature dachshund with a naturally anxious disposition. Since joining Laoise and her wonderful team, Walter has blossomed in confidence and happiness. He absolutely loves the beach walks and park explorations, and it’s been heartwarming to see him socialise so well with the other dogs. I have complete peace of mind knowing he’s in such caring and capable hands. Every time he returns from a day with OutPaws, he’s relaxed, content, and clearly thriving. I’m so grateful for the love and attention they give him!

We’ve had our dog Aussi with OutPaws now for 6 months and he absolutely loves it. They have been a massive help with training, walks and daycare facilities. He loves visiting Laoise, Georgia and his favourite person in the world Oliwia!

I got so lucky when I hired Outpaws to care for my pup for our time in Dublin. I easily arranged things before leaving NYC and they followed through on everything we agreed and always arrived on schedule. The dedicated sitter/walker is a dog whisperer and soon to be veterinarian. They took in around 6 parks in the area along with many walks along the canal. I already cherish the photos and videos taken during their playtime. Absolutely a great team of dog lovers. I wish I could take them along on our further travels in Ireland.
Thank you Victoria for leaving Outpaws a 5 ✨⭐️ review! We hughly appreciate you taking the time to endorse myself & the amazing team 😇🐾 …
So happy Amy was able to watch our dogs! She sends lots of updates and pictures. The whole team is lovely. Would highly recommend!

Chewy is our little Chihuahua and with us travelling often, there is no better care than Rose and the team from Outpaws.  They give him love and cuddles just the way he likes it. We are so grateful for them, looking after Chewy as if he is …

Thanks for all your hard work and patience with Kobe! He adores you all and we are definitely reaping the benefits of all the hard work you guys put into making him a better pup! Amazing service and we look forward to working with you next year
